title: AI film startups are setting up studios in Hollywood, using US and Chinese AI models while touting lower production costs and a way around traditional financing (Robert Booth/The Guardian)
summary: Robert Booth / The Guardian: AI film startups are setting up studios in Hollywood, using US and Chinese AI models while touting lower production costs and a way around traditional financing — Amid fears for jobs, some film-makers say AI could enable them bypass studio giants and take more creative risks
